title: IB Biology
text:
1 Welcome
Welcome to IB Biology.
This online textbook is designed to help high school students develop a strong conceptual understanding of biology.
The goal isn’t simply to memorize biological facts. Instead, we will focus on understanding how biological systems work, how scientists investigate them, and how different areas of biology connect with one another.

title: IB Biology
text:
1.1 How to use this textbook
Each chapter contains explanations, diagrams, examples, and opportunities to test your understanding.

title: IB Biology

1.2 Start learning
Our first topic is Cell Biology.

title: 2  Cell Biology
text:
2.1 Introduction
Cells are the fundamental units of living organisms.
In this chapter, we will explore how cells are organized, how their structures relate to their functions, and how cells interact with their environments.

title: 2  Cell Biology
text:
2.2 Learning objectives
By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

explain the basic principles of cell theory
distinguish between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells
identify major cellular structures
relate cellular structures to their functions

title: 2  Cell Biology
text:
2.3 Why cells matter
All organisms are made of one or more cells.
Although cells can differ enormously in size, shape, and function, they share important characteristics.
Understanding cells provides a foundation for understanding many other areas of biology.

title: 5  Ecology
text: This chapter explores interactions between organisms and their environments.

title: 4  Genetics
text: This chapter introduces genes, inheritance, variation, and the relationship between DNA and biological traits.

title: 3  Molecular Biology
text: This chapter introduces the molecules and chemical processes that are fundamental to life.
